plot: At midnight in the kitchen the five bros' names write themselves in spilled flour and a circle closes around Pim's name; Zeek's Ghost-o-Graph sees nothing and the night watch falls asleep, until Bup's big eye sees the letters walking: an ant colony led by Queen Marcha wrote a protective warning that the tall thing from the roof comes down tonight for the most scared one, the bros thank the ants with the sugar bowl, and a clunk sounds in the oven hood early.

script.title: Who Is Writing Our Names in the Flour

beats.say: AAAH! Bup! The flour just wrote my name! All by itself!
Flour can't write, Pim. Flour can't even spell.
In the spilled flour, five names appear. One letter at a time.
Bup, Pim, Lolly, Zeek, Crispy. Fascinating. Also deeply rude.
Who's writing in my clean kitchen at midnight? Show yourself, sweetie!
Nobody answers. The sugar bowl clinks. One cube is missing.
The s-s-sugar is gone too! The ghost has a sweet tooth!
Zeek, you have a gadget for this. You always have a gadget.
Behold! The Ghost-o-Graph. It photographs anything invisible.
Flash! The photo shows flour, five scared faces, and nothing else.
Conclusion: the ghost is camera shy. Or my lens is buttered.
Buttered? Zeek! That was my good birthday butter!
Wait. Did that P just... wiggle? My big eye saw it wiggle.
Letters don't wiggle, Bup. You need a nap, honey.
Tonight?! Tonight WHAT? I hate sentences with no ending!
Flour does not write itself. Something in here is hungry... and patient.
Crispy! Don't sneak up on a cookie with icing nerves!
Slowly, a circle draws itself around one name. Pim.
It picked Pim. If we can't stop it, we lose him tonight!
Why always me?! I'm mostly water and fear!
Nobody touches our bean. Pim, into the measuring cup. Now.
Pim hides in a measuring cup. His shaking makes it ring.
Plan B. We stay awake and guard the flour. All night.
Soon Zeek is snoring. Lolly is snoring. Bup's small eye closes too.
Stay open, big eye. You're the only good eye I've got.
Two circles around Pim. Whatever it is... it's almost finished.
Then I'll sweep the whole flour away! Every last speck!
Lolly raises the broom. Bup leans in, close to the flour.
Lolly, STOP! The letters are walking! Tiny legs! Hundreds of them!
An ant army wants ME? I'm a terrible snack!
A snack? Ew. Beans give us tummy aches.
I'm Queen Marcha. We weren't hunting Pim. We were warning him.
Warning? You circled his name twice! That's threatening handwriting!
Circles mean protect. Something is coming for Pim tonight. Read the rest.
The ants march again. New words crawl across the flour.
Down from where? Only one thing lives above this kitchen.
The tall one on the roof. It hunts the scared ones.
Why the scared ones? What did scared ones ever do?
Fear smells sweet to it. Like warm syrup on a pancake.
Then I'm basically a cupcake! I'm the sweetest coward in Table Land!
Queen Marcha, why help us? Ants and dough aren't exactly friends.
You drop the best crumbs in Table Land. We protect our bakery.
Lolly gives the ants the sugar bowl. They cheer in tiny voices.
Thank you, ants! I'll drop extra crumbs forever! On purpose!
And I'll upgrade the Ghost-o-Graph. Ant mode. Tiny flash.
That came from the oven hood. It's early.
Early?! Nobody told me EARLY was an option!

long.title: Who Is Writing Our Names in the Flour? 😨
long.description: At midnight in the kitchen, the names of all five Dough Bros appear in spilled flour, one letter at a time… then something draws a circle around Pim. Zeek's Ghost-o-Graph sees nothing. Who do YOU think is writing? 👇 #animation #doughbros #horrorcomedy

El Fantasmógrafo de Zeek no ve nada. ¿Quién crees TÚ que está escribiendo? 👇 #animación #doughbros #comediadeterror
